subject: Re: Project Sirocco kickoff: CFQ as a first-class eval product
body:
Dmitri,

Plan for Sirocco:

Staffing — Saoirse 50% on dataset hosting + the cfq1.1 tarball ingestion into Corpus; Amara 40% on the eval harness; Hyun 40% on baseline reproduction (we need trustworthy reference numbers before a leaderboard means anything); Rosa 30% on the leaderboard UI, starting March.

Compute — baseline reproduction is the only heavy part. Reproducing the Transformer/Universal Transformer baselines is cheap, but a T5-11B-class run needs real accelerators: requesting 128 A100s on Titan best-effort for three weeks in March. If we get preempted too much I'll come back about a Vulcan slice.

Dependencies — Evalline for score submission (talked to Tomas, they're fine with an April integration), and Corpus for hosting.

Feels doable inside the window.

Santiago
